name: Fathom Dollar
oneLiner: FXD is Fathom Protocol's CDP-minted dollar on XDC, overcollateralized by XDC and stabilized by liquidations plus a StableSwap Module.
collateral: Overcollateralized XDC and protocol collateral-pool positions in Fathom Protocol
pegMechanism: Users mint FXD from collateralized debt positions, repay and burn FXD to close positions, and rely on liquidations plus the StableSwap Module to support the dollar peg

oracleRisk.summary: Three debt-bearing XDC pools use 15-minute-delayed, one-hour-valid feeds. XDC and psXDC share one XDC/USD path; CGO has a separate aggregator, but both aggregators have exactly one active node, the same reporter, and no secondary feed.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: An exhaustive LogInitCollateralPoolId scan through finalized XDC block 104920353 found exactly XDC, CGO, and psXDC. Each collateral adapter remained live and each pool had positive debt shares, so all three are represented and no inactive pool is inferred from documentation alone.

branches.label: WXDC collateral
branches.summary: The WXDC pool uses a 15-minute delayed XDC/USD value sourced from a one-node Fathom aggregator and rejects the feed for safety operations after one hour without a fresh upstream timestamp.

feeds.path: Sole reporter 0x7ee0d8c9a1374e3d5ce33d48cd09578251af708f -> latestRoundData; upstream implementation 0x38634a4a034ce3b3289a2be8fe4f348f5fff385a is unverified

branches.fallbackBehavior: There is no secondary feed. A failed upstream retrieval is caught and the stored delayed value remains usable until its upstream timestamp exceeds 3,600 seconds; then isPriceOk is false, liquidation is blocked, and PriceOracle updates can set the safety price to zero. readPrice itself continues returning the stored value.

collateralParameters.note: 25% close factor; 5% gross collateral incentive; 80% of the incentive portion is directed to SystemDebtEngine.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Whitelisted callers can immediately execute fixed-spread liquidation when a position is unsafe. The liquidator pays FXD, receives seized WXDC at the configured incentive, and residual uncovered debt is confiscated to SystemDebtEngine.
branches.backstop: Liquidation depends on whitelisted external liquidators. Protocol fee and liquidation surplus held by SystemDebtEngine can settle recorded system bad debt, but there is no committed Stability Pool or insurance reserve. At the observed block, 423,345.826467397288 FXD-equivalent surplus exceeded 322,052.371253126181 FXD-equivalent recorded bad debt; that point-in-time coverage is not guaranteed.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Owner-only shutdown permanently cages core modules. Each pool must be caged using a healthy delayed feed; positions are processed into collateral claims and system bad debt. After a configured one-to-thirteen-week cooldown, finalized FXD claims redeem pro rata against remaining collateral, while SystemDebtEngine settles the minimum of available surplus and bad debt.

branches.label: psXDC collateral
branches.summary: The psXDC pool reuses the WXDC delayed XDC/USD path and has no separate psXDC/XDC exchange-rate feed, so it prices psXDC one-for-one with XDC.

feeds.path: Same delayed-feed implementation and XDC/USD FathomPriceOracle as WXDC; no psXDC/XDC exchange-rate feed

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FXD token source does not show a direct blacklist, but Fathom AdminControls can pause core modules including bookKeeper, positionManager, and stablecoinAdapter. Treat as a possible mutable holder-facing protocol-control surface.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: FXD is minted from collateralized debt positions on XDC; the StablecoinAdapter proxy (0xe3b248) holds MINTER_ROLE on the FXD token. Both the FXD token proxy and the StablecoinAdapter proxy are managed by a single ProxyAdmin (0xb82ad475) whose owner is EOA 0x594d425a. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE has been renounced. The EOA can unilaterally upgrade the FXD token and StablecoinAdapter logic, making this concentrated-admin.

controls.label: StablecoinAdapter (MINTER_ROLE holder, proxy 0xe3b248)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-position overcollateralization against XDC and collateral-pool assets, with liquidations and a StableSwap Module supporting the peg.
controls.evidence: At XDC block 103659775: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xe3b248) on FXD token proxy returned true. RoleGranted log at block 0x3908e89 confirmed MINTER_ROLE granted to 0xe3b248 by EOA 0x594d425a. No RoleRevoked events found. 0xe3b248 is a transparent proxy (EIP-1967 admin = ProxyAdmin 0xb82ad475; impl = 0x5fe6d7b4c22e3fbf010438e6d8f5144c083d2efb, i.e., StablecoinAdapter).

controls.label: FXD ProxyAdmin EOA owner (0x594d425a — upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: At XDC block 103659775: ProxyAdmin 0xb82ad475 owner() = 0x594d425a; eth_getCode on 0x594d425a returned empty (EOA). Same EOA appears in RoleGranted logs as the granter of MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE at token initialization (block 0x3908d35). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder count = 0 (renounced). However, the EOA-owned ProxyAdmin controls upgrades to both FXD token and StablecoinAdapter, giving unrestricted unilateral upgrade power over the mint path.

upgradeability.controlRef: FXD ProxyAdmin EOA owner (0x594d425a — upgrade authority)

review.evidence: At XDC block 103659775: FXD token 0x49d3f754 is a transparent proxy with ProxyAdmin 0xb82ad475fc113671840d510b60cbae5630a07f3b (confirmed contract). ProxyAdmin owner() = EOA 0x594d425a6c9249f66a00c841a7a2a921b63a0a4c (eth_getCode = empty). FXD token impl = 0xe4cd2c8f09e8f03839bc5cdbdb097515d3c11d3a. MINTER_ROLE (0x9f2df0fe...) hasRole confirmed true for StablecoinAdapter proxy 0xe3b248a97e9eb778c9b08f20a74c9165e22ef40e; RoleGranted log confirmed at block 0x3908e89. No RoleRevoked for MINTER_ROLE. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE getRoleMemberCount = 0 (renounced). ProxyAdmin also controls StablecoinAdapter proxy (EIP-1967 admin = same 0xb82ad475). The EOA upgrade authority over both contracts constitutes concentrated-admin; posture updated from partially-bounded-admin.
